_about: Scripted answers for StubClassifier (scout/classifier.py), used until a real model is in models/. Each batch gets a fixed top-3 of [condition_id, confidence]; the photo is ignored. Only the 4 model classes are allowed (MODEL_CLASSES). Each top-3 has one other-crop class, which the crop filter drops. 'default' is used for batches not listed and for scans without a QR code: low confidence on purpose, so it shows as 'Not sure'.
